title: Paraprofessional - Elementary Art
status: Part Time, 24 hours per weekMinimum Requirements:Associate's degreeor48 semester hours from an accredited college/universityorpassing results on an approved Paraprofessional Assessment.Elementary Art Instructional ParaprofessionalDiamond Valley Elementary School is seeking an instructional paraprofessional to teach visual art to all students in kindergarten through fifth grade. Students come to the art room in scheduled groups by grade level. The paraprofessional leads each class using the school'sMeet the Masterscurriculum and guides students through hands-on art projects.Primary responsibilitiesPrepare and teachMeet the Masterslessons for students in grades K5.Introduce students to featured artists and their work, demonstrate basic art techniques, and guide students as they create their own artwork.Adapt directions, demonstrations, and projects to the age and needs of each group.Manage student behavior and establish routines for using materials safely and cleaning up.Organize art supplies and equipment and let the office know when supplies need to be replenished.Preferred qualificationsExperience working with elementary-age students in a classroom or group setting.Ability to lead a class, give clear directions, and demonstrate project steps in ways children can follow.Interest in visual art and willingness to learn and teach theMeet the Masterscurriculum.Formal art training and professional art experience are optional.The salary for this position is assigned to Lane 1 of the SC Salary Schedule.To view the salary schedule, please select the following linkSC Salary Schedule.Attachment(s):Paraprofessional.pdfEmail To A FriendPrint Version
